recent.text: On November 23, 2017, the @LAKings acquired forward Torrey Mitchell from the Montreal Canadiens for a fourth round draft pick. Mitchell scored six goals and 11 points in 49 games with the #LAKings. #GoKingsGo https://t.co/f0w15mtLc6

recent.text: On November 23, 1997, Luc Robitaille scored his fourth career overtime goal in a 2-1 win versus the Colorado Avalanche. Robitaille's game-winner was his first overtime goal with the @LAKings since Dec. 20, 1990. #LAKings #GoKingsGo https://t.co/WeLC27I1Ll
recent.author: The Kingstorian

recent.text: On November 23, 1991, Wayne Gretzky scored his 49th career hat trick, and sixth hat trick with the @LAKings. Luc Robitaille recorded three assists, and Bob Kudelski scored his 10th goal of the season in a 6-4 win over the San Jose Sharks. #LAKings #GoKingsGo https://t.co/tACRrAd1L4

recent.text: On November 23, 1988, @LAKings center Wayne Gretzky became the fifth player in NHL history to score 600 goals. Gretzky reached the milestone in his 718th career game in an 8-3 win versus the Detroit Red Wings. #LAKings #GoKingsGo https://t.co/u7k1HeeGCu

recent.text: On November 23, 1977, the @LAKings set a record for four fastest goals in franchise history. Syl Apps, Hartland Monahan, Pete Stemkowski, and Ernie Hicke scored in 2 minutes and 21 seconds in the first period in an 8-3 win versus the Chicago Blackhawks. #LAKings #GoKingsGo https://t.co/6E6oC8F8YL
